dialogue.origin: 今日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for seeing me today.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします。では始めますね。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming. Let's get started, shall we?

dialogue.origin: お願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。 お越しくださりありがとうございます。本日はどうされましたか？
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in. What brings you in today?

dialogue.origin: 学校辞めたいです
dialogue.content: I want to quit school.

dialogue.origin: よろしければ、はじめに年齢、性別を教えていただけますでしょうか？
dialogue.content: If you don't mind, could you please tell me your age and gender to start?

dialogue.origin: 15歳女子です
dialogue.content: I'm a 15-year-old girl.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。学校辞めたくなってしまっているのですね。
dialogue.content: Thank you. So, you're feeling like you want to quit school.

dialogue.origin: なにか原因となる出来事があったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Did something happen that made you feel this way?

dialogue.origin: はい・・・行きたくないです実習が嫌で…　しんどいです
dialogue.content: Yes... I don't want to go because I hate the practical training... It's really tough.

dialogue.origin: 実習があるのですね。何がしんどいと思われてますか？
dialogue.content: I see, you have practical training. What about it feels tough for you?

dialogue.origin: 調理コースなんですけど、あんまりにも周りと実力とかが違いすぎて…
dialogue.content: I'm in a culinary course, but the difference in skill between me and everyone else is just too great...

dialogue.origin: いつも皿洗いばっかりしてるんです
dialogue.content: I'm always stuck washing dishes.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね…実力の差でできることが変わってきてしまうということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see... So are you saying that the skill gap determines what you get to do?

dialogue.origin: 初めからそうなんで、場違いなとこに来た感じです
dialogue.content: It's been like that from the very beginning. I feel like I'm in the wrong place.

dialogue.origin: 周りができる人がいるとそう感じてしまうのも無理はありません…
dialogue.content: When you're surrounded by such capable people, it's understandable to feel that way...

dialogue.origin: やっぱ、場違いなんですよね
dialogue.content: So I really am out of place, aren't I?

dialogue.origin: 場違いと感じてしまっているのですね…その学校に通ったのはなにか夢とかがあったからなんですか？
dialogue.content: So you're feeling out of place... Did you have a particular dream or goal that led you to attend that school?

dialogue.origin: ただ、調理ができるようになりたかっただけです
dialogue.content: I just wanted to learn how to cook.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…でも調理が現状できていなくて皿洗いの毎日で嫌になってしまっているのですね。
dialogue.content: I see... But right now you're not getting to cook, and you've grown tired of washing dishes every day.

dialogue.origin: そうです、情けないです
dialogue.content: That's right. I feel so pathetic.

dialogue.origin: 周りは皆レベル高くて意識高い方ばかりなのですか？
dialogue.content: Is everyone around you highly skilled and very motivated?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。専門店の2代目とか、パティシエになりたいとかいう子もいます
dialogue.content: Yes. Some are heirs to specialty restaurants, or want to become pastry chefs.

dialogue.origin: それはお辛い状況ですね。皆さん意識がとても高い方ばかりなのですね・・・
dialogue.content: That sounds like a difficult situation. It seems everyone is very driven...

dialogue.origin: だから、下働きするしかないみたいな感じです
dialogue.content: So it feels like I have no choice but to do the menial work.

dialogue.origin: あなたと同じような境遇の方は周りにはいらっしゃらないですか？
dialogue.content: Is there anyone else around you in a similar situation?

dialogue.origin: いると思うけど、いつも皿洗いばっかりなのは私位です
dialogue.content: I think there might be, but I'm about the only one who's always stuck with washing dishes.

dialogue.origin: それは辛い状況ですよね・・・皿洗いのために入学したんじゃないと思ってしまいそうです・・・
dialogue.content: That must be a painful situation... I can imagine you thinking, 'I didn't enroll in this school just to wash dishes.'

dialogue.origin: はい…情けないです
dialogue.content: Yes... I feel pathetic.

dialogue.origin: 皿洗いは順番とかそういうのではなくどうやって担当が決まるのですか？
dialogue.content: How is the dishwashing duty decided? Is it not done in turns?

dialogue.origin: 特に決まりはありません、グループごとに自然にやっています。
dialogue.content: There aren't any specific rules; it just happens naturally within each group.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・バンビさんは自然に皿洗い担当になっているということか？
dialogue.content: I see... so you just naturally end up being the one to wash dishes?

dialogue.origin: 先生が采配とかしてくれないのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do the teachers not step in to assign roles?

dialogue.origin: それはないです
dialogue.content: No, they don't.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・グループメンバーはいつも変わるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see... Do the group members change often?

dialogue.origin: 1学期はきっとこのままだと思います
dialogue.content: I think it will probably stay this way for the first semester.

dialogue.origin: その先はわかりません
dialogue.content: I'm not sure about after that.

dialogue.origin: 自然と決まってしまっていて、いつも皿洗い担当になってしまうならそれを覆すのは難しい状況ですね・・・
dialogue.content: If it's decided naturally and you always end up with dish duty, it must be a difficult situation to change...

dialogue.origin: 今は学校は１年目でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is this your first year at the school?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…今までグループメンバーに何か自分の意見を言ってみたこと等はあります？
dialogue.content: I see... Have you ever tried to voice your opinion to your group members?

dialogue.origin: はい、やろうとしたけど、嫌な顔されて、結局できません
dialogue.content: Yes, I tried to, but they gave me a nasty look, and in the end, I couldn't go through with it.

dialogue.origin: それは辛い状況でしたね
dialogue.content: That must have been a painful experience.

dialogue.origin: でも勇気をもってやろうとされたんですね
dialogue.content: But you gathered the courage to try.

dialogue.origin: はい、でも、もう完全に下に見られていると思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, but I feel like they completely look down on me now.

dialogue.origin: それなのにその反応だと、もういいやと思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: After getting a reaction like that, it's understandable that you'd feel like giving up.

dialogue.origin: もう、気持ち、切れました
dialogue.content: I've just had enough.

dialogue.origin: それは学校行きたくなくなる気持ちも分かります
dialogue.content: I can understand why you wouldn't want to go to school anymore.

dialogue.origin: だれか周囲に相談できる友人や大人はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anyone around you, like a friend or an adult, that you can talk to?

dialogue.origin: 辞めたいけど、親には言えません
dialogue.content: I want to quit, but I can't tell my parents.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。。。ほかに相談できそうな先生等はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: I see... Are there any teachers you might be able to talk to?

dialogue.origin: 面談あるんですけど、辞める相談した方がいいですよね？
dialogue.content: I have a meeting coming up—do you think I should bring up quitting?

dialogue.origin: 面談があるのですね。あなたはもし調理ができるようになるとすれば、辞めたいとは思わなくなるとおもいますか？
dialogue.content: You have a meeting, I see. If you were able to do some cooking, do you think you might not want to quit?

dialogue.origin: できるとしても、役に立たない自分に嫌気がさしそうで…それはそれでしんどいです
dialogue.content: Even if I could, I think I'd get fed up with myself for being useless... That would be tough in its own way.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・では状況が変わっても辞めたいという意思は変わらなそうですか？
dialogue.content: I see... So even if the situation changed, it sounds like your desire to quit wouldn't change?

dialogue.origin: 本当はやめたくないけど、自信なくなりました
dialogue.content: I don't really want to quit, but I've lost my confidence.

dialogue.origin: 本当はそう思ってらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: So deep down, that's how you feel.

dialogue.origin: 毎日皿洗いをして勇気出しても嫌な顔されてしまい自信がなくなってしまっているという状況ですね
dialogue.content: So, you're washing dishes every day, and when you mustered the courage to speak up, you were met with a negative reaction, which has caused you to lose your confidence.

dialogue.origin: はい・・・
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 自信はどういう状況になれば取り戻せそうですか？
dialogue.content: What kind of situation do you think would help you regain your confidence?

dialogue.origin: わかりません…魔法がかかったみたいに、みんなにやさしくしてもらえたら・・・？
dialogue.content: I don't know... Maybe if, like magic, everyone started being nice to me...?

dialogue.origin: そんな風になるととても良いのですが…周囲を変えるのは難しいと思うんです。
dialogue.content: It would be wonderful if that could happen, but I think it's difficult to change those around you.

dialogue.origin: 状況を変える方法を一緒に考えていけたらと思います。
dialogue.content: I would like for us to think together about ways we might be able to change the situation.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね…
dialogue.content: You're right...

dialogue.origin: 調理がやりたいという気持ちはあなたも周囲と変わりないです。モチベーションが違うのは学校であれば普通のことだと思います。
dialogue.content: Your desire to learn to cook is the same as everyone else's. I think it's normal for students at a school to have different levels of motivation.

dialogue.origin: 普通…
dialogue.content: Normal...

dialogue.origin: 皿洗いするのを一切やめる日を作ってみるのは難しいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be difficult to try having a day where you don't do any dishwashing at all?

dialogue.origin: ボー――っとしてるんですか？
dialogue.content: And do what? Just stand there and space out?

dialogue.origin: 難しいですね・・・・何か他にできそうなことはありますか？
dialogue.content: That would be difficult, wouldn't it... Is there anything else you might be able to do?

dialogue.origin: 質問があるんですけど
dialogue.content: I have a question.

dialogue.origin: もし途中で退学したとしたら、学費とかって、返ってくるんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: If I were to drop out, would I get any of the tuition fee back?

dialogue.origin: 学費は学校の最初の契約にもよると思いますが、帰ってこないことがほとんどたと思います。
dialogue.content: Regarding tuition, it likely depends on your initial contract with the school, but in most cases, it is probably not refunded.

dialogue.origin: そこは契約書によると思うので要確認ですね
dialogue.content: That's something you would need to confirm in the contract.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・・
dialogue.content: You're right...

dialogue.origin: 辞めたい気持ちと続けたい気持ちはどのくらいの割合ですか？
dialogue.content: Roughly what is the balance between your wish to quit and your wish to continue?

dialogue.origin: 今は気持ち、落ちちゃってるので、辞める事ばっかり考えてます
dialogue.content: Right now I'm feeling down, so quitting is all I can think about.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。クラスの人に嫌な顔をされてしまったのは最近の出来事なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I understand. Did the incident with your classmates giving you a nasty look happen recently?

dialogue.origin: 5月くらいからです。居心地悪いです
dialogue.content: It's been happening since around May. I feel so uncomfortable.

dialogue.origin: １か月も我慢されているのですね。居心地悪いと行きたくなくなるのも当然ですね…
dialogue.content: So you've been putting up with it for a whole month. It's only natural you wouldn't want to go if you feel uncomfortable...

dialogue.origin: もうしょっぱなから、カーストの底辺です
dialogue.content: From the very beginning, I've been at the bottom of the social ladder.

dialogue.origin: 今まで辛抱されてきたんですね
dialogue.content: You've been enduring it all this time.

dialogue.origin: あなたは結構周りの顔色伺ってしまうタイプですか？
dialogue.content: Do you tend to be quite sensitive to the moods of those around you?

dialogue.origin: 結果、そうなのかも…
dialogue.content: I guess, in the end, I might be...

dialogue.origin: お話聞いてるとそのように感じました
dialogue.content: That's the impression I got from listening to you.

dialogue.origin: 周囲の顔色が分かってしまうの辛いですよね
dialogue.content: It must be hard being so aware of what people around you are thinking.

dialogue.origin: お気持ち察します
dialogue.content: I can imagine how you feel.

dialogue.origin: 今日はそろそろ時間となってしまったので、また改めてお時間いただいてもいいですか？
dialogue.content: It looks like we're almost out of time for today. Would it be alright if we schedule another session?

dialogue.origin: はい、聴いてくれてありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you for listening to me.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそご相談ありがとございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing with me.

topic.sub: 実習でのコミュニケーション問題
